title: Golden manifest declares 4000 ticks but provided diff ends at tick 1992
detail: Hunk header claims a 4007-line new file; the 7-line header block leaves 4000 tick lines expected. The diff shown stops at tick 1992 with no subsequent hunks — 2008 lines unaccounted for.
recommended_fix: Verify the committed file contains ticks 1–4000 (4007 lines). If it genuinely ends at 1992, regenerate the complete t1 golden before merge.

title: Per-tick FNV-1a-64 full-state hash golden is opaque and maximally brittle
evidence: +# t1 manifest — per-tick FNV-1a-64 state hashes (full sim state) | +ticks 4000
detail: One intentional behavior change invalidates all 4000 hashes, and FNV avalanche means a single tick divergence cascades into thousands of mismatches with zero signal about which entity diverged.
recommended_fix: Add lower-frequency per-entity hashes (e.g., per-100-tick subsystem snapshots) so golden mismatches localize instead of failing wholesale.
